info.name: Redfin Data Center CSV Export Search API

params.name: region_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a Redfin region.

params.name: region_type
params.description: The type of region to search. Values include 1 (neighborhood), 2 (ZIP code), 5 (county), 6 (city).

params.name: uipt
params.description: Property type filter. Values include 1 (house), 2 (condo), 3 (townhouse), 4 (multi-family), 5 (land), 6 (other). Multiple values can be comma-separated.

params.name: status
params.description: Listing status filter. Values include 1 (active), 130 (pending), 131 (active and pending).

params.name: min_price
params.description: Minimum listing price filter in USD.

params.name: max_price
params.description: Maximum listing price filter in USD.

params.name: num_beds
params.description: Minimum number of bedrooms filter.

params.name: max_num_beds
params.description: Maximum number of bedrooms filter.

params.name: num_baths
params.description: Minimum number of bathrooms filter.

params.name: max_num_baths
params.description: Maximum number of bathrooms filter.

params.name: min_year_built
params.description: Minimum year built filter.

params.name: max_year_built
params.description: Maximum year built filter.

params.name: min_listing_approx_size
params.description: Minimum approximate square footage filter.

params.name: max_listing_approx_size
params.description: Maximum approximate square footage filter.

params.name: min_parcel_size
params.description: Minimum lot/parcel size filter.

params.name: max_parcel_size
params.description: Maximum lot/parcel size filter.

params.name: num_homes
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per request.

params.name: page_number
params.description: Page number for paginated results.

params.name: user_poly
params.description: Custom polygon coordinates defining a geographic search boundary.

items.docs: Performs a geographic information system search for properties within a specified region. Returns property listings matching the provided filters including price range, property type, bedroom and bathroom counts, and geographic boundaries.

items.docs: Alternative GIS-based property search endpoint. Returns property data in JSON format matching the specified region and filter criteria. Supports polygon-based geographic boundaries and all standard property filters.
